topics.title: Nate's ex-CEO indicted for faking "AI" with human workers
topics.why: Federal prosecutors say Albert Saniger raised $40M pitching an AI shopping app that was secretly run by overseas human workers -- a sharp warning for anyone evaluating "AI-powered" tools at face value.

topics.title: Z.ai ships GLM-5.3-Flash, its first fully multimodal model
topics.why: The 320B-parameter open-weight model claims a jump from 46.2 to 63.4 on the DeepSWE coding benchmark, more evidence open labs are closing the gap with frontier US models fast enough to matter for tool picks.

topics.title: Oracle cuts 25K jobs while profit jumps 95% on AI spending
topics.why: Oracle's net income hit $6.13B this year even as it slashed a quarter of its workforce to fund AI infrastructure -- a preview of the tradeoff more knowledge workers should expect as employers redirect headcount budget into compute.
